cand.title: Inaugural 2026 WNBA season
cand.excerpt: Toronto’s first WNBA team launched an inaugural season with home games primarily at Coca-Cola Coliseum and selected games at Scotiabank Arena; visiting WNBA teams, league personnel, media and sponsors create a recurring sports-event lodging opportunity.
cand.selectionWhy: Prior blocked-promising candidate (no exact date/contact in thin ledger)

verifyPrev.futureEditionText: 2026 is past and outside the December 2026–June 2028 prospecting horizon. The next indicated cycle is 2027: official Ticket Central says '2027 Single-Game Tickets Coming Soon'; the Cross-Canada Series page says 'Will be back in 2027' and 'Stay tuned for more information when the schedule is released.' No officially published 2027 or 2028 game dates were located. Upcoming start/end dates and game-s
verifyPrev.venueText: Historical only: Coca-Cola Coliseum primary; Scotiabank Arena selected 2026 Toronto games. No verified game-specific 2027 assignment.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Lisa Ferkul, Chief Revenue Officer, oversees sponsorship and ticketing; Teresa Resch is President. Both are commercially relevant relationship-routing candidates, not verified hotel-contract buyers.
findings.futureEdition: None announced: no exact 2027 start/end dates located as of 2026-11-15. The official team page says '2027 Single-Game Tickets Coming Soon'; the Cross-Canada Series says 'Will be back in 2027' and awaits schedule release. The WNBA confirms a 2027 season but says key dates will be announced later. No exact 2028 dates located; do not assign dates within the horizon from a typical seasonal pattern.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using supplied hotel constraints: consider only modest visiting-party, sponsor/VIP or fan-group lodging, subject to buyer confirmation. Do not position the 157-room hotel as exclusive season housing or infer room demand from ticket sales.
findings.venueCommitments: Coca-Cola Coliseum is the home venue promoted in the official 2027 suite offering. This is a season-level venue indication, not a dated game assignment. The membership page explicitly says Scotiabank Arena games are not currently confirmed. No game-specific 2027 venue/date pairing verified.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. Ticket memberships and arena suite sales are not hotel accommodation tenders or evidence of available room blocks. No hotel procurement timetable or lodging buyer verified in this limited date-verification pass.
findings.organizationStructure: Professional WNBA franchise, not an association conference; WNBA team profile names Kilmer Sports Ventures as owner.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Retain a year-only/date-pending status. Monitor official schedule and ticket updates; ask commercial leadership to route an accommodation inquiry to the responsible travel/operations buyer before proposing any dates or room block.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The inaugural 2026 season is not the future edition being qualified. No dated 2027 lodging opportunity has been established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship development may be appropriate ahead of the 2027 schedule release, but neither bookable dates nor accessible hotel inventory is verified.
